name: Impressionism
description: MJ7 Update: The MJ7 dataset was recreated using MidJourney V7. It has a better versatility, but it is not as strong as the previous 2 versions. You can start from higher LoRA strength/weight when using it. The Lora is trained on MidJourney Images that use my "Personalised Style" + Impressionism V2 is highly flexible, but the effects are not as prominent as V1. Works without the trigger words ArsMJStyle, Impressionism Will start adding visible effects at 0.4+ Works great in the 0.6 - 1.5 range, depending on your preference It depends on the model, but you can go pretty high with this Lora's weight. Quality tags and negatives reduce the effect.
